blocks.text: foodpanda puts the spotlight on the punong-abala this holiday season, helping make room at the table for the person who brings Christmas together Christmas has a way of filling the house—and the calendar—very quickly. Between planning the menu, watching the budget, preparing the food, and accommodating last-minute guests, there’s always someone making sure everything is ready for everyone: ‘the punong-abala’. This holiday season, foodpanda is celebrating the punong-abala through its Make Christmas Delicious campaign, recognizing the people who bring every gathering together and reminding them that they deserve to enjoy the festivities, too.
